summary: Richmond County tower on a 2016 tnlandforms list with BLL and older GFC numbers; no history, staffing or site status found.

evidence.supports: Tobacoo record: Richmond County, coordinates, 462 ft, BLL-50819 and gfc-026
The list was last revised in March 2016
BLL numbers belong to the 118 towers whose coordinates GFC provided
gfc-nnn numbers come from an older GFC list that described 203 towers
evidence.quote: an older GFC list described the locations of 203 towers (gfc-nnn).

evidence.supports: Names for towers numbered 73 and above are the page author's own
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: Staffing on the state's towers was cut back steadily from the late 1980s
evidence.quote: Since the late 1980s, the state has steadily cut its fire tower staff

evidence.supports: In 1987 the state staffed 93 towers full time and 73 seasonally
evidence.quote: in 1987, the state staffed 93 towers full time and 73 seasonally

evidence.supports: 2006 spreadsheet: 137 of 144 still-existing towers no longer staffed
evidence.quote: 137 of the state's 144 still-existing towers are no longer staffed.

evidence.supports: 119 of the unstaffed towers are listed as antenna towers
evidence.quote: Of those, 119 are listed as "antenna towers."

sources.title: Fire towers are fading into history

notes_for_editor: The list gives elevation with no unit; the story reads it as feet.Only one 2016 list supports this record. No source found for build date, status, access, staffing, height, design or photos, so none is set. Agency is not set: the list shows GFC and BLL numbers, not ownership. The name is the list author's label, not a documented name. The list tags the tower 'usgs' without explaining the tag, so the story does not use it. A business directory lists the GFC Richmond County unit at 2615 Tobacco Rd, Hephzibah; not used, since nothing ties this tower to that road. The Savannah Now article is read from a Wayback Machine copy because the live site returned 403; statewide context only. The NHLR Georgia list (29 registered lookouts) does not name this tower.
